scripts.check:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const files=[...fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')),...fs.readdirSync('lib').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>'lib/'+f)];for(const f of files){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status!==0)process.exit(r.status||1);}console.log('Syntax OK ('+files.length+' files)');"
